repos.android-app: React Native Expo, Realm DB local, custom pako-compressed /sync/buffer NestJS sync logic
repos.app-backend: NestJS backend with MongoDB database (Migrated to apps/backend in mono repo)
repos.infra: Docker Compose containing MongoDB, Kong API Gateway, SSL certificates

packages.packages/shared: Exports raw Typescript Zod validation schemas & interfaces directly across packages. Standardizes split mandatory patient names (firstName & lastName) with optional computed fullName, and updated generatePatientIdInitials helper.
packages.apps/pwa-app: Vite PWA SPA supporting tablet mode (VITE_APP_TARGET=tablet) and web dashboard (VITE_APP_TARGET=dashboard). Includes real-time form autosaving (1-second debounce to PouchDB), validation error toast alerts, 120-year max age limit for DOB, reusable InfoButton popovers for clinical guidelines, dynamic preset chip localization (translatePreset) saving English strings in DB, split name inputs with autosave guards, location card hiding with default background coordinates, complete multi-language support (EN, AR, TI) across forms, previews, and PatientsList.tsx, and ClinicalAiGuideModal for volunteer-friendly clinical guidance.
packages.apps/backend: Lightweight Fastify server with tsx runtime, direct CouchDB changes feed integration for sequential patient ID generation (supporting split firstName/lastName and legacy fullName parsing), Zod validation, and automatic CouchDB CORS setup on boot.
packages.packages/rag-builder: High-performance GPU matrix embedding builder (ncbi/MedCPT-Article-Encoder, sqlite-vec, FTS5) with GPU batching (64 items/call) and incremental append mode.
packages.packages/rag-eval: Retrieval evaluation benchmark package using ncbi/MedCPT-Query-Encoder measuring Context Recall@5 and Zod schema compliance.

database_transition.client: Realm DB -> PouchDB (browser IndexedDB storage) using single VITE_COUCHDB_BASE_URL variable for LAN target configuration. Deferring initial draft document creation until firstName, lastName, and birthDate are populated to prevent invalid IDs. Includes dynamic seeding of offline afiyet_icd10 (500+ diagnostic entries) and afiyet_custom_entries.
database_transition.server: MongoDB -> CouchDB. Backend configures afiyet_patients, afiyet_examinations, afiyet_icd10, and afiyet_custom_entries on startup.
database_transition.replication: Replaced manual pako transaction queue sync with native PouchDB-to-CouchDB sync (PouchDB.sync live, retry). Support for manual resync with overlay toast notifications.
database_transition.automatic_server_provisioning: Fastify backend automatically configures CouchDB CORS endpoints on startup.

pwa_offline_constraints.caching: vite-plugin-pwa generateSW, autoUpdate, inline registration for instant offline startup
pwa_offline_constraints.camera: Browser getUserMedia API for taking patient photos (Base64 avatar storage)

locales.layout: i18n.ts applies document.documentElement.dir = 'rtl' dynamically. Full translation keys structured across card namespaces (vitalsCard, extendedVitalsCard, rapidTestsCard, clinicalAssessmentCard, reproductiveHealthCard, clinicalPhotosCard, presets).

test_suites.pwa_tests: Run via 'npm run test:pwa'. Covers offline PouchDB integration tests, split name validations, and form validation tests with Vitest.
test_suites.rag_tests: Run via 'npm run test:rag'. Evaluates retrieval recall and clinical response schema validation.

knowledge_base_specs.storage_format: SQLite on-disk vector database with sqlite-vec (768-dim Float32) and FTS5 BM25 full-text index

curated_datasets.who_guidelines: 30 chunks (WHO Infectious & Tropical diseases, Maternal/Child health protocols)
curated_datasets.statpearls_msd: 17 chunks (StatPearls MSD Emergency & Clinical Assessment guides)
curated_datasets.medlineplus: 1,015 chunks (NIH MedlinePlus primary health topics encyclopedia)
curated_datasets.medical_textbooks: 125,684 chunks across 18 gold-standard textbooks (Harrison's, Nelson Pediatrics, Robbins Pathology, Katzung Pharmacology, First Aid Step 1 & 2, Gray's Anatomy, Novak Gynecology, Williams Obstetrics, Schwartz Surgery, DSM-5 Psychiatry)

knowledge_base_specs.excluded_datasets: Pruned 2.5M generic Wikipedia dump and 30M PubMed raw abstracts to avoid vector dilution and keep DB under 500MB for instant tablet RAM cache search (<30ms latency).
knowledge_base_specs.builder_gpu_specs: Built on Razer Blade Advanced (Intel i7, 32GB RAM, RTX 2070 Super Max-Q) using ONNX Runtime DirectML/CUDA with batching size 64 at 9.7 chunks/sec.

mobile_models.llm: MedGemma-4B-IT (medgemma-4b-it-Q4_K_M.gguf, ~2.48 GB GGUF) running locally on Android tablets via llama.cpp native bridge (LlamaPlugin) from /sdcard/Afiyet/models/medgemma-4b-it.gguf.
mobile_models.query_encoder: ncbi/MedCPT-Query-Encoder (768-dim float vectors) running ONNX in-app transformer runtime.

android_tablet_deployment.database_bundling: afiyet_med_knowledge.db (402 MB) is bundled into APK assets (assets/databases/afiyet_med_knowledge.db) and auto-unpacked on initial boot by MainActivity.java into /data/data/org.afiyet.mobile/databases/afiyet_med_knowledge.db.
android_tablet_deployment.aapt_options: noCompress 'db' in build.gradle ensures 402 MB database is packaged uncompressed for instant memory-mapped file access and zero AAPT heap memory issues.

npm_commands.android:build: Builds tablet PWA, syncs Capacitor, preps vector DB in APK assets, and compiles app-debug.apk
npm_commands.android:install: Installs compiled app-debug.apk onto connected tablet/emulator via ADB
npm_commands.android:push-model: Creates /sdcard/Afiyet/models/ and pushes MedGemma GGUF (2.48 GB) and MedCPT Query Encoder ONNX (435 MB) over ADB
npm_commands.android:deploy: Single command workflow: builds APK and installs it directly onto the tablet

android_tablet_deployment.verification_walkthrough: WALKTHROUGH.md documents root cause analysis, SqliteVecPlugin.java fix, and real-device clinical test screenshots for Male (Mild) and Female (Critical) cases.

volunteer_friendly_ui.formatting: Presents clear plain-English step-by-step guidance first, formal clinical medical terms in parentheses, medication notes (e.g. re-dosing if patient vomits), and explicit hospital referral red-flag warnings.
volunteer_friendly_ui.triggers: Accessible from active ExaminationForm.tsx and submitted VisitSummary.tsx via 'Get AI Guidance' button.
